warm_density: For all one/two-source-key union age prefixes as existing setup_density, score completed_groups/(L*ACTUAL extra source walks from common prefix probe + d*count descriptors). Do not include capacity wait in score. Same lawful capacity gate, same overlap, same payload work. Tie older group, fewer extra walks, lexical. This is ordinary source-miss accounting including warm-first/eviction, not candidate ACK-aware duration.
fixed_cohort_tile: k=1,2,3 fixed for the whole run, count consumer groups. At each cohort boundary choose oldest unfinished group g0; form age prefix of up to k still-unfinished groups whose FIRST declared source page equals g0's FIRST declared source page (within complete static source domain; unrelated payload). Include g0. Complete ALL remaining copies in this cohort before opening the next cohort. In cohort choose currently hot source page if one has remaining copies; otherwise page with largest remaining fanout, ties oldest group/descriptor declaration. Batch matching descriptors by group age; use existing common executor/safe incoming slot helper with partial-group fallback to avoid all-head deadlock. Any partial-group fallback must stay inside cohort and choose legal own remaining dependencies. Current hot page may become next cohort's first page, regardless declaration order, because all sealed inputs are reorderable. k limits cohort, not number of fragments. Never mix outside groups to make a cohort advantageous. k=1 resembles one-group warm-first; k=2/3 give ordinary batching choices. All three are predetermined static parameters; best per-case is an optimistic tuned SIMPLE comparator, not an online adaptive result.
capacity: Every input dispatch reserves actual slot; ACK only frees. All own source READ+hot target WRITE/model service same. Cohort<=k each<=2 inputs, B2 case must split safe heads and finish groups rather than fail. Do not force entire cohort payload resident simultaneously or forbid ACK freeing during cohort. If impossible report invalid comparator with exact reason instead of counting candidate win.
